detail: MainLayout reversed DOM order (content column now precedes Sidebar) so the frozen mobile landmark selector resolves to a visible element. At lg+ this puts main content before the sidebar navigation links in tab order. All controls remain reachable; not inaccessible. Necessary consequence of the F1 fix.

title: aria-modal=true while header hamburger (outside dialog) remains interactive
detail: Mobile drawer is role=dialog aria-modal=true, yet the header hamburger (outside the dialog) stays interactive as an alternate close affordance. Minor ARIA-correctness nuance; not a genuinely inaccessible/misleading modal contract (Escape/backdrop/route-change also close; hamburger has accessible name and is keyboard reachable; focus restored to it).
evidence: Sidebar.tsx drawer markup (role=dialog aria-modal=true, top-16) vs Header.tsx hamburger (sticky top-0 z-20)
